senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גלד)coating, skin; thickness. Y. B. Bath. III, 13ᶜ top עד מקום שעושה ג׳ the fifty cubits of legal distance from the inhabited place are counted from the end of the town to the place where he flays the carcass.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 44b:15">Yoma 44ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>בכל יום היה גִּלְדָּהּ עב והיום דק</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) all the year around the pan was of a thick size, and this day (Day of Atonem.) it was thin.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>קערה גִּילְדָּהּ … גִּילְדּוֹ דק</he> the charger was of a heavy size, the bowl &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27b:3">R. Hash. 27ᵇ</cite> if he scraped the Shofar <he>והעמידו על גִּלְדּוֹ</he> and reduced it to its due size.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7:5">Lev. R. s. 7</cite> <he>וא״ת דהוה ג׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="C00939"><he>גָּלִיד</he></cite>) but you may think the bronze on top of the altar was a solid mass, v. <cite ref="C00487"><he>גּוֹרְדְּיָינִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:2">Mikv. IX, 2</cite> <he>ג׳ שחוץ למכה</he> (Maim. <he>גָּלִיד שעל גבי וכ׳</he>) the scab surrounding the wound (Maim.: on the wound).—Pl. <he>גְּלָדִים</he>, constr. <he>גִּלְדֵּי</he>, <he>גִּילְדֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ג׳ צואה וכ׳</he> the scabby, dirty spots on one’s body.
